description: Returns an app's addresses: `url`, the link users open, and for its owner or team `pre`, a private link to the test copy as last saved (not its draft) that must be opened within 10 minutes and then works 4 hours in that browser (lasting tester access: neblla_pre_access). `promoted`: whether users have a version; `draft`: unpublished changes. Use it rather than building a URL. Changes nothing. More: neblla_get_llms tools/get_app_url

appId.description: The app's public ID, from neblla_list_apps.

name: neblla_get_app_url
title: Get an app's public address
